findings.title: The paid session and the course are not linked from the home page, the menu or the pages a visitor reaches from them
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A visitor who starts at talouloren.com finds no way to the one bookable offer (the 60-minute session at 1000 ₪) or to the BRAND YOURSELF course: the menu lists HOMEPAGE, SERVICES, VLOG OF SUCCESS, CASE STUDY and MEET TAL, and none of the eight pages walked links to /winning-personal-brand/ or /course/; they are reached from Linktree.

value: HOMEPAGE · SERVICES · VLOG OF SUCCESS · CASE STUDY · MEET TAL

findings.playbook_ref: §2 what does it cost; §5 booking path
findings.fix_in_new_site: services[] rows for the Focused Check, the Clarity Session, the sprints, Partnership and the course, each with its own page (services[].page) and ctaText, all in the main menu and on the home page
findings.notes: tools/funnel.mjs (30 pages, depth 3) never reached either page, which agrees with the walk

findings.title: The home button "קבעו עכשיו" (book now) opens a page of three quizzes, not a booking
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Tapping the gold "קבעו עכשיו" on the first screen opens /meet-tal/ ("SUCCESS MEETING"), which asks the visitor to pick ארגון / יזם\יזמית / מותג and go to a quiz; nothing on that page books a meeting.
findings.fix_in_new_site: the first-screen action is contact.whatsapp (wa.me with a prefilled line) and the persistent mobile bar carries the same action; the Focused Check is a services[] row with its own page, never behind a "book" label

findings.title: Each quiz opens on an empty step with only a "הבא" (next) button
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On /entrepreneur-quiz/, /organization-quiz/ and /brand-quiz/ the first screen shows the quiz name, a phone link and a "הבא" button, but no question; a visitor has to tap on without knowing what is asked or how long it is.
findings.fix_in_new_site: the Focused Check (services[] row, group lead) states its length and that it is free before the first question (direction must-do 6); built and mocked by the template per A10
findings.notes: not tapped past the first step: no form is filled or submitted (auditor constraint 10)

findings.title: On a phone, WhatsApp and the phone number are not on the first screen and the phone is not tappable
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The first phone screen offers only "קבעו עכשיו"; the WhatsApp icon sits inside the hamburger menu, and the number +972 50 4635536 appears near the bottom of the page as plain text in a "PARTNERSHIPS & BARTERSHIPS" box, so a tap does not dial.

evidence.value: funnel/funnel.json (landing_actions: no tel; the whatsapp link is 37×42 px, tap_target_ok false)

findings.fix_in_new_site: contact.whatsapp and contact.phone drive a labelled first-screen action and the persistent mobile bar; the footer shows both as links
findings.notes: tools/funnel.mjs reports the WhatsApp link as above the fold (top 332) because it reads the menu markup; the screenshots show it only after opening the menu

findings.title: The session page's booking buttons work only with JavaScript
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On /winning-personal-brand/ "הזמן שיחה עם טל" opens a popup with the phone, a WhatsApp button and a three-field form (name, email, phone) — two taps to a message; with JavaScript off or blocked, the same buttons go to /SuccessfulPersonalBrandMobile, a 404.
findings.fix_in_new_site: plain links: the WhatsApp action is an <a href="https://wa.me/…">, never a script-only trigger

findings.title: The course page counts down to a 2020 deadline
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The course price block says the special price of 990 ₪ holds "עד התאריך 10/10/2020" and then rises to 1755 ₪, with a days/hours/minutes countdown beside it: six years after the date, a visitor cannot tell what the course costs today.
findings.playbook_ref: §2 what does it cost; §7 honesty of facts
findings.fix_in_new_site: services[].price with a fixed unit and no deadline; brief: no countdowns; new prices are placeholders until decided

findings.title: The Instagram strip above every footer is broken
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Above the footer every page shows "השראות להצלחה עסקית @TALOU_LOREN" over a row of empty tiles with play icons and no pictures; the page source carries the plugin's message "There has been a problem with your Instagram Feed".
findings.fix_in_new_site: socialLinks[] (instagram) as a link; instagramTiles[] only when seeded with the account's own posts — the build never calls Instagram

findings.title: Two of the proof videos do not play
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The AMT case study embeds a removed YouTube video, and the vlog post "הצלחה היא פנים ארגונית" embeds a mistyped id, so a visitor gets a YouTube error where the story should play.
findings.fix_in_new_site: videos[] seeded from the dossier's fetched files (vid-024 AMT, vid-026), each with a poster; caseStudies[] link their video

findings.title: The session and course pages promise returns of 10x to 1000x
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The pages say an investment "תחזיר את עצמה פי 10, פי 100... ואפילו פי 1000!" and name celebrities as past clients; the brief drops both.
findings.fix_in_new_site: copy from the dossier's client facts only; proof as clientLogos[] and caseStudies[] (A4, A19)

findings.title: The home page weighs 2.5 MB on a phone and its main image paints at about 2.7 s
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On a 390 px phone the home page transfers 2,529,447 bytes before load and its largest paint lands at 2,684 ms.
findings.fix_in_new_site: poster-first hero (heroVideo + heroVideoPoster, renditions ≤ 2 MB mobile) and responsive images from the build
findings.notes: measured by dossier/talouloren/make-old-site.sh (harvest), not by tools/funnel.mjs

findings.title: The footer still shows an office address and a "CAREERS" box from 2021
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Every page ends with "CAREERS WITH TALOU LOREN … בת עמי 3, מתחם נגה, תל אביב" and "© 2021"; the partners do not want an address shown (A23).
findings.fix_in_new_site: no address field filled (contact.address empty by client choice); footer carries contact.email, contact.phone, contact.whatsapp, socialLinks[]

recommended.offer_framing: two doors (Story, Launch) and the ladder as services[] rows: the free Focused Check first, then the Clarity Session (fee credited), sprints, Partnership, the course; each row ends in its own ctaText; prices as visible placeholders until decided
recommended.closing_intent: send the reader to one of the two actions the brief names (start the Focused Check or book a Clarity Session), with WhatsApp beside them for a question

off_site.advice: point the Instagram bio and Linktree at the new site's Check and Clarity Session pages once it is live

not_measurable: conversion or enquiry volume — no analytics access
reply time on WhatsApp, phone and the forms — no contact made (constraint 10)
the quizzes past their first step and the session popup form — never filled or submitted
Cardcom checkout — curl got HTTP 525 from cardcom.solutions/e/x1lV; the page links secure.cardcom.solutions/e/x1lV, not opened (no purchase started)
notes: A11: the new site is a parallel venue, not a replacement; talouloren.com stays up and this audit describes it as the current presence.
